prompts.magic: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for a top-down fantasy action game for 10-year-old children. TRUE pixel art, sharply stepped square pixel clusters as if each cell originally 64x64 enlarged with nearest-neighbor. NOT smooth painting, NOT vector lines, no blur, no photographic glow. Transparent RGBA background, no text, no borders, no grid, no labels, no checkerboard painted in. Exactly FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 16 isolated animation cels, generous transparent 12% margins in EVERY cell; no overlap. Read each row left to right as four stages of one spell: gather, grow, impact, fading fragments. Each row has an entirely DIFFERENT recognizable spell, kept consistent across its 4 columns. Whole sheet square, ideally 1536x1536. Original polished colorful console RPG pixel VFX, dark outline accents and bright contrasting pixel cores. Rows top to bottom: 1 teal and gold spiral star-wave circular burst surrounding an EMPTY clear center. 2 pale blue frost field with chunky ice crystals sprouting around empty center. 3 yellow zigzag electric bolt from LEFT to RIGHT centered horizontally, branched pixels and sparks; no circular backdrop. 4 orange fiery meteor descending diagonally from upper left, impacting into a compact circular amber star explosion. Crisp animated magical shapes rather than UI icons.

prompts.bow: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent RGBA PIXEL ART weapon animation atlas for an original top-down console fantasy RPG, crisp square pixel clusters, as if each cel originally 48x64 pixels enlarged nearest-neighbor, NO smooth edges, no blur. Exactly FOUR equal columns in ONE row, wide 3:1 overall sheet. Every cel isolated with at least 15% padding, same bow scale and anchor point at cell center. One elegant golden wooden recurve bow with teal gemstone, oriented VERTICALLY, tips above/below, curved limbs bowing to the RIGHT and string to the LEFT. It always fires arrows exactly RIGHT. Four cels left to right: 1 idle bow with relaxed straight string, 2 arrow nocked pointing right with string being pulled left slightly, 3 arrow still nocked pointing right and string pulled far LEFT into a V while the bow flexes, 4 string released/straight and a small right-facing arrow leaving the bow. A long distinct arrow shaft, feathered tail and silver arrowhead, NEVER a gun or crossbow, NO muzzle flash. No hands, no character, no scene, no text, no grid or borders. Clear authentic bow draw animation. Original friendly polished RPG sprite.
